label: Gouache Poster

traits.medium: hand-painted gouache landscape poster with opaque matte color shapes
traits.texture: chalky matte paint, decisive brush edges and sparse dry-brush marks
traits.composition: simplify the garden into distinct depth layers; preserve the tree rhythm and path
traits.lighting: clear daylight described with flat light and shadow shapes

review_checks: tree rhythm and path survive simplification
limitations: A poster aesthetic does not supply print layouts or guarantee exact typography.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.
